atoms.text: Oliver lives in a small town. Just outside the town is a field where lots of strawberries grow. Strawberries are Oliver’s favourite fruit, so one day he decided to go strawberry picking. He picked all the strawberries he could find because he was very hungry. As a result, he was too full to eat dinner when he got home.

The next morning, Oliver woke up and went to pick more strawberries. However, he could not find very many, and he went home feeling hungry. During dinner, there was a knock on the door. It was their neighbour, Mrs Mariani, who lived down the street.

instruction.text: Read and listen to the dialogue. Fill in the gaps as you go.

atoms.b: Hello! Sorry to bother you. Do you have any strawberries I could have? I could not find any in the field, ((++so because)) I came here to see if you might have some.
Hello Mrs Mariani. I ate all the strawberries I found yesterday, ((++so while)) I can’t give you any.
Oh, that makes me very sad, ((++because while)) I was planning to bake a strawberry pie tomorrow for all of us to share.
However, ((++since why)) there are no strawberries, I cannot bake one.
I’m very sorry I took all the strawberries in the field.
It’s okay Oliver. Fortunately, more strawberries will grow soon. Next time, only take what you need, ((so_that why)) there will be enough strawberries for everyone.

hint.text: The cause of an action is the reason why something happened. The effect of an action is the result.

instruction.text: Read the following sentence again to work out the cause and the effect.

atoms.text: Strawberries are Oliver’s favourite fruit, so one day he decided to go strawberry picking.

atoms.a: What is the cause in this sentence?
b: Oliver went to go pick strawberries

atoms.a: What is the effect in this sentence?
